original_task: Offline partially labeled Known and unlabeled Known/Novel image GCD with known total class count; not persistent causal video category discovery.

model_outputs: DINOv1 ViT-B/16 CLS768 clipped then origin exponential map in same dimensional Poincare ball; Mobius linear+bias projected output supplies fixed Known+Novel logits. args.mlp_out_dim256 does not instantiate a learned projection MLP on this active HypSimGCD path.
losses: Known CE/SupCon, all-image detached opposite-view self-distillation plus batch mean-entropy regularizer, and angle-versus-negative-hyperbolic-distance contrastive objectives whose distance weight linearly ramps. Known/unlabeled balance0.35. Distance representation uses same-image positives, not across-video same-category matches.

online_or_offline: Joint offline training over full mixed dataset; image-only static inference with fixed classifier, no test-time adaptation or arrival updates.
causal_or_noncausal: Inspected eval model receives image only and appends labels solely for external batch metrics. No historical state/futureframe input; this structural fact is not an actual GT/future/ID mutation or persistent-memory certificate.
state_memory: Fixed known total classifier cardinality; no dynamic birth/token allocation, WAIT, reversible category membership, crossvideo semantic lifecycle or versioned output ledger.
evaluation: Eval-only branch skips training but constructs all datasets/loaders first, loads model/projector/classifier and evaluates unlabeled Train queries. Training selects best weights using disjoint Test old-ACC after mixed-global Hungarian; Known IDs can be remapped. This selection/remapping is forbidden for our fixedKnown/independentfold/sealed protocol.
static_source_paper_differences_not_exec: Main HypSimGCD directly ToPoincare(backbone768)→HypLinear768/K; declared mlp dimension256/3layers unused in construction. Paper256 projection concerns nonparametric GCD, not proof that this entry uses256.

ToPoincare defaults train_c=False/train_x=False, so map has no trainable parameters; standalone HypLinear stores ordinary nn.Parameter, RiemannianAdam actual classifier update path. No claim every tensor is geoopt ManifoldParameter.

Distance weight=(epoch+1)/200 with default start0/end200, not exactzero firstepoch. Angle temperatures are scaled by script hyper_temp_scale; both distance and angle branches computed even at finalzero blend weight.
Paper main defaultcurvature0.05 finegrained/0.01 generic differs from shell examplec0.1 andCIFAR100c0.05. Exact paper/source/checkpoint experimental settings not bound.
Paper main cosine endpoint0.001 differs from source eta_min=args.lr*1e-3=0.0001 forlr0.1. Shellmemax1 differs from main default2.
test() sets hyperbolic heads eval; next epoch student.train() only. Inspected heads contain no dropout/BatchNorm so this flag distinction is not an asserted training numerical failure.
Training best-test selection reads disjoint Test targets; eval funcs v2/v2b can globally relabel Known rows. Not lawful Train selection or CT persistence even if image-forward itself ignores labels.

CUB loader opens attributes for metadata but returns only image/target/index; no attribute/text feed in audited path. No CUB data, split pickle, GT annotations, weights or TAOTest assets were read here.
Paper covers nonparametric semi-supervised kmeans andHypSelEx; those source bodies, DINOv2 backbone and count estimator were not read/executed, not counted in audited14files.
Base environment geoopt/hyptorch dependencies not installed, weights not fetched, GPU inference/training not run; static numerical formulas are not performance validation.
paper_limitations_summary: Main hyperparameter studies show curvature/clipping/loss weighting dataset sensitivity; no dedicated main limitations section read. Fixed-K offline GCD and no online lifecycle are inferred transfer limitations, not a claimed proof of hierarchical causality or our adapter-collapse solution.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Alternative geometry plus explicit Raw/frozen controls offers a bounded representation mechanism for observed rank/pseudoNovel discrimination loss. Published image results do not establish same-semantic crossvideo consistency or fix early contaminated state writes.
what_to_borrow: Independently implemented, Train-selected geometric control with exact loss normalization and Raw comparison, legal predicted-track positives and independent pseudoNovel folds.
what_not_to_borrow: True novel cardinality, Test-selected best weights, mixedHungarian remapping as fixedKnownCT, sameinstance contrast as semantic persistence or offline fixed head as versioned memory.
